resources.string: Enabled · dormant until you open a file

FlexyFiles only accesses the file you choose. It does not scan your files or conversations. Even when enabled, it stays dormant until you choose Explore contents in a document menu. Processing is local. Edits are saved to a copy; the original is unchanged. Tools are released on close. ZIP and text up to 256 KiB are supported within safety limits. RAR, 7z, encrypted or oversized files are not supported in this version. A ZIP entry may need temporary extraction. Drafts are retained only when you choose to save them.
